game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats, flats of tall cacti: the caravan guide must hold off scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what scarab swarms changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats: flats of tall cacti
core_gameplay_loop: In Cactus Flats, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what scarab swarms changed. Then check trace_clarity and advance.
player_objective: Protect the temple door from scarab swarms in Cactus Flats: keep trace_clarity above zero until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 4, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

learning_objectives: Understand the idea behind: Debugging & Combined Skills

hint: Read the code panel: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what scarab swarms changed. Keep trace_clarity above zero until the timer reaches 55.

tutorial.message: Scarab swarms are coming! Watch the trace_clarity meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: print('x =', x)
Survive for 55 seconds to complete the level.

on_win.title: Level Cleared!
on_win.message: You mastered Print Tracer in Sand Dunes!

on_lose.title: Try Again!
on_lose.message: trace_clarity ran out. Fix the code sooner and watch the meter!
